question: Write a program for creating GUI for reserving bus ticket, store the passenger information in file. Give concession for senior citizen, child and army people. Keep seat reserved for privileged people till one hour before the departure time. Use exception for the invalid date, name. Amount. Ticket id must be generated automatically. Only once name of the bus should be stored in memory.
